explanation: Span agrees within 0.5 %, so the model is NOT uniformly mis-scaled; scaling by 1040/1117 would shrink the span to ~1.44 m.

The length excess is concentrated ahead of the wing: matching the top-view and side photos puts the wing-root leading edge about 42-56 mm closer to the propeller plane than the model has it (photo frame x 186-200 mm vs 242 mm in the model), i.e. the nose/cowl section is about 50-60 mm too long.
The remaining ~15-25 mm is within the uncertainty of where the reference measures length (spinner tip vs cowl, rudder TE vs fuselage end) and of photo perspective.

Not corrected in r1 on purpose: moving the wing forward changes the CG/main-wheel relationship of the model (the estimated CG would sit almost over the axle). A fix needs either the manufacturer's CG/dimension drawing or a long-lens, perpendicular side photo with a scale.
reconciliation.recommended_fix: shorten the fuselage between firewall and wing LE by ~50-60 mm (non-uniform), then re-verify CG and gear position
